source: use the 3D Model Generation tool to build me a Rocket League in 3D

image_prompt.text: A goal mouth at each end of the pitch, wide and open enough for a ball to be driven into
A curved wall closing the arena off and containing the ball and the cars
A centre kickoff spot with symmetric car start positions facing it

layout_placement.text: A detection volume inside each goal mouth registering a score when the ball crosses it
Static reset positions for the ball at centre and for each car at kickoff

notes: Physics Sport preset taken whole; the prompt is a title reference only, so every option is preset-derived.
Sports rather than Racing: the finish condition is a score, not a lap.

open_questions.ask: No theme was stated - should the arena read as clean futuristic sport, or something grittier?
